itemText: Run the follow-up passes after extraction (embed, tag, cards, dedup, subject assignment) as one debounced Inngest job with a cheap pending-work check (unit U4 in units.md).
Stop processing new knowledge inside the API process when Inngest is on, so a failed send leaves the item pending instead (unit U2 in units.md).
Make prod always run ingestion through Inngest, refuse to boot without the Inngest keys, and fail the deploy loudly when the keys are missing (unit U1 in units.md).
Queue the follow-up passes when an extraction stores items, and run every regeneration through Inngest (unit U6 in units.md).
Add a five-minute sweep endpoint that re-queues pending knowledge and only calls Inngest when work exists (unit U3 in units.md).
Replace the seven knowledge scan scheduler jobs with the single five-minute sweep job in infrastructure code (unit U7 in units.md).
Stop article summaries and card variants from falling back to in-process work when Inngest rejects a send (unit U8 in units.md).
Remove the unused DBOS engine so Inngest is the only durable engine (unit U5 in units.md).
Update the docs and local-dev notes so they describe Inngest as the ingestion engine and the free-plan budget (unit U9 in units.md).
Push to main, watch the deploy turn green, and confirm the prod API answers its health check.
Sync the prod API with Inngest Cloud so its jobs are registered, then confirm the import and extraction jobs are listed.
Import all of subjects/Business.txt into prod under the business sub-subjects and confirm every note became raw knowledge with suggested cards.
